name: GanttChart
label: Gantt chart
description: Phases and tasks as bars on a shared timeline, with milestones, progress, and a today rule.

props.name: milestones
props.description: Point-in-time markers, each rendered as its own diamond row at the end of its group.

props.name: range
props.description: Explicit timeline window (YYYY-MM-DD both ends). Without it the range fits the data. Either way the window snaps outward to whole months, so an explicit range starts on the first of its start month and runs to the end of its end month.

props.name: showToday
props.description: Draws the vertical today rule when today falls inside the range.

props.name: today
props.description: Pins the today rule to a given day (YYYY-MM-DD) instead of the render-time clock, so a statically built page and its hydrating client can never disagree about where the rule sits.

props.name: showGrid
props.description: Draws the faint vertical gridline at each month boundary behind the bars.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Id of the highlighted item. Selection is controlled; pair it with `onItemClick`.

props.name: onItemClick
props.description: Called with the item when a bar is clicked. Bars render as buttons only when this is set; without it the chart is inert and renders from a Server Component.

props.name: title
props.description:
Chart title, in the shared chart header.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which GanttChart does not expose.

props.name: bare
props.description: Strip the card chrome (border, padding, fill) when the chart sits inside another panel that supplies the surface

props.name: todayLabel
props.description: The visible label on the today rule. Defaults to "Today".

props.name: locale
props.description:
The BCP 47 locale the dates are written in: the month names on the axis
("Jan 2026", then "Feb"), and the days in each bar's and milestone's
tooltip and accessible text ("Mar 9, 2026"). Defaults to `en-US`.

props.name: rangeLabel
props.description: The span in a bar's tooltip and accessible text, given its first and last day already formatted in `locale`. Defaults to "<start> to <end>".

props.name: progressLabel
props.description: The completion in a bar's tooltip and accessible text, given the rounded percentage. Defaults to "<percent>% complete".

props.name: projectedLabel
props.description: The word a `projected` bar's tooltip and accessible text carries. Defaults to "projected".

GanttChartColor.description: Accent roles a Gantt bar or milestone can take — the core accent vocabulary shared with EventCalendar.

GanttChartItem.description: One task bar on the timeline.

GanttChartMilestone.description: A point-in-time marker on the timeline, drawn as a diamond on its own row.
